title: Unconstrained detection of productive autocatalytic cores is NP-complete
summary: We prove NP-completeness of deciding whether a finite reversible reaction network contains a productive autocatalytic core when neither a target species nor an allowed-food set is specified. The input is a binary encoding of literal nonnegative integer reactant and product matrices, with a signed real flow on each reaction identity. A nonsingular square-witness characterization gives polynomial certificates.
